brief.headline: Cut payment terms from 45 to 30 days to free up ₹2.25 L cash, and benchmark cap pricing against the market fair band of ₹0.85–0.95/pc with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume

priceAsk.summary: Push pricing toward the lower end of the market fair band, targeting ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volume or looser spec
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market headroom band) vs current market typical of ₹0.85–0.95/pc
priceAsk.basis: Open-market ask for 28 mm PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, and the market verdict flags modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — we spend ₹27.42 L annually, so we should be in that lower zone

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment terms from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.25 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Abhinav's financials are not public, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. We spend ₹27.42 L a year with them — a meaningful chunk for a private packaging converter. Without their numbers, our leverage comes from our purchase data, the market price bands we see, and lining up a second source. We can push on price and terms, but we need a backup qualified fast because we're negotiating blind on their health.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L annually on rigid plastic packaging with them
Current payment terms are 45 days after receipt
Cutting terms to 30 days frees up cash for us
Market ask for 28 mm PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict shows modest headroom to a lower band at volume
HDPE resin import unit value (raw material benchmark) is 87.61 ₹/kg

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100), makes pharma bottles and caps — strongest second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B (73/100), serves pharma with pails and containers — robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging firm at ₹749.82 Cr revenue, health C (51/100), broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Abhinav publishes no financials, so we have no view on their stability, cash position or how dependent they are on us — we're negotiating blind
We have no internal price benchmark (no bestPriceWePay data) for rigid plastic packaging, so our only anchor is the open-market ask band — harder to prove a gap
All three strong alternates listed are leads from web research, not yet qualified or priced — if Abhinav walks, we have no approved second source ready today
Pushing too hard on price and terms together with a private supplier whose health we can't see could risk supply continuity if they're fragile
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹27.42 L a year with you on caps and want to bring our terms to 30 days and our unit price down toward the ₹0.65–0.80 band we're seeing in the market at volume — let's talk about how we get there together.
